svg.title: Reconstruction of three-panel figure: model architecture, Hopfield energy, and neural activities
svg.desc: Base frames f01, f02, and f03 contain panels (a), (b), and (c). Panel (a) inventories two input distributions I1/I2 above state nodes x1/x2, vertical arrows to nodes and to actions, and a bidirectional curved coupling loop between nodes. Panel (b) inventories a square energy heatmap with axes x1/x2, colorbar, white trajectory scatter, green nullcline-like guides, and a red path. Panel (c) inventories a time-series plot of x1 and x2, legend, axes labels, and right-side marginal density curves. Symmetry basis: panel (a) is approximately bilateral around the midpoint between x1 and x2; panel (b) is square-coordinate symmetry with opposing low/high regions; panel (c) is horizontal time progression with state values on the vertical axis.
